name: beauticode
description: Local image/video backgrounds for DeepSeek Harness (also Codex Desktop). Unofficial.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @beauticode/core && npm run build -w @beauticode/adapter-codex && npm run build -w @beauticode/adapter-dsh
scripts.test: npm run test -w @beauticode/core && npm run test -w @beauticode/adapter-codex && npm run test -w @beauticode/adapter-dsh
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @beauticode/core && npm run typecheck -w @beauticode/adapter-codex && npm run typecheck -w @beauticode/adapter-dsh
scripts.tray: npm run build && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File apps/tray/start-tray.ps1 -SkipBuild
scripts.tray:dsh: npm run build && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/start-beauticode-dsh.ps1 -SkipBuild
